name: ic-more-qualities
title: IndustrialCraft - More Qualities
author: mimic
description: Adds 40 new qualities. Local unpublished Paranoidal extension: experimental defect qualities and ten quality-control research levels. Handcraft, machine, drill/pumpjack and natural-object mining handlers are connected; intended loss chance decreases from 50% to 0%. Includes configurable ingredient exclusions and pole reductions, crafting-machine energy penalties and scripted drill slowdown/pollution. Cycles of two ticks or less are skipped. Productivity, fluids and depletion are approximate. Engine loading, item safety and gameplay are NOT verified; implementation remains incomplete. Use a separate test game only.
